inviteSheet.title: Invite new agent
inviteSheet.name: Name
inviteSheet.subject: You're invited to ANANDA
inviteSheet.body:
Hi [Name],

You're invited to join ANANDA as an agent. You'll see your own customers and orders, create new sales, and track your commission ({perUnit} a unit, paid once the customer has paid in full).

Click the link below to set your password. It works for {days} days. Then add your company and bank details and sign the agent agreement in the app.

{sender}
inviteSheet.hint: They set their own password from the link.
inviteSheet.sent: Invitation sent. It waits under Invitations.

countersign.title: Countersign {name}'s agreement
countersign.sub: Company and bank details are in. Countersign to finish their set-up.
countersign.name: Your full name
countersign.agree: I've read the agreement and I can sign for {company}.

setupBanner.title: Finish your set-up
setupBanner.text: Add your company and bank details and sign the agent agreement.
setupBanner.waitingText: Usually within a working day. You'll get an e-mail and a notification.

setup.title: Finish your set-up
setup.saved: Saved. Pick up where you left off any time.

company.title: Company details
company.lead: ANANDA pays your commission to a company. Tell us which one.
company.vatHelp: A Bulgarian EIK has 9 digits; a VAT number is BG and the EIK.
company.lookupHint: We fill in the rest from the EU VAT register (VIES).
company.notFound: Not found in VIES. Fill in the details below.
company.down: VIES didn't answer. Fill in the details below.
company.vatYesNote: Your commission invoices add 20% VAT, as the Earnings tab shows.
company.vatNoNote: Your commission invoices won't add VAT.
company.euVatHelp: We check it in VIES. Commission invoices then use reverse charge.
company.noEuVat: No EU VAT number outside the EU.
company.fullNameHelp: As in the passport or ID

bank.title: Bank details
bank.lead: Where we pay your commission, once a sale closes.
bank.holderHelp: The company's name, as your bank shows it. Personal accounts can't be used.
bank.ibanHelp: Bulgarian IBANs start with BG and have 22 characters.
bank.ibanBad: This IBAN doesn't add up. Check for a missing or swapped character.
bank.bankAddressHelp: Needed for transfers outside the SEPA area.
bank.eurHelp: ANANDA pays commission in euros, by SEPA transfer.
bank.confirmationHelp: A bank letter or a statement header with the company name and IBAN. It speeds up the first payout.
bank.drop: Drop a PDF or photo, or
bank.fileTypes: PDF, JPG or PNG · up to 15 MB

contract.title: Sign the contract
contract.lead: Read the agent agreement, then sign it the way that suits you.
contract.version: Version {v} · filled in with your details
contract.paidOutValue: When the customer has paid in full
contract.customersValue: Yours for {months} months from each order
contract.how: How do you want to sign?
contract.digitalText: Type the full name of the person who signs. It is recorded with the date and time.
contract.typeName: Full name of the person who signs
contract.paperText: Print it, sign it by hand and upload the scan.
contract.paperHint: Sign the last page and initial every page.
contract.upload: Upload a scan or clear photos of all pages
contract.agree: I've read the agreement and I can sign for {company}.
